DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お名前を確認し、順番でお呼びします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: We will check your name and call you in order.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 名前を大きな声で呼ばれるのが気になります。番号で呼んでもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 番号での呼び出しを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am uncomfortable having my name called loudly. Could you call me by number?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request a numbered call. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この場面では番号でのご案内ができます。番号の札をお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: In this situation, we can use a number. Please keep your numbered ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。札は持ちます。相談内容も待合で詳しく話さずに済む場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 待合で相談内容を話さない場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thank you. I will keep it. Is there also somewhere I can avoid discussing the details in the waiting area?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for a place other than the waiting area to discuss details. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 内容を伺う席へご案内します。ただし、完全に周囲へ聞こえないと保証するものではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will show you to the consultation seat. However, we do not guarantee that nothing can be heard by others.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。声の大きさを抑えて説明し、必要なことをメモでも見せたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 完全な遮音とは考えずメモによる説明を提案する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I will keep my voice down and would also like to show the necessary points in a note.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not assume complete soundproofing; suggest a written explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、メモをお使いいただけます。本人確認は担当の席で行います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, you can use notes. Identity verification takes place at the staff member's desk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 名前を伝えないまま手続きができるという意味ではないんですね。席では本人確認に応じます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 呼び出し方法と本人確認の必要を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: So this does not mean I can complete the procedure without giving my name. I will cooperate with identity verification at the desk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the calling method from required identity checks. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのとおりです。呼び出し方と、手続きで必要な確認は別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Exactly. How we call you and the checks required for the procedure are separate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。番号の呼び出しを待ち、担当席でメモと本人確認書類を出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 番号を待ち担当席で必要資料を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will wait for my number and show my note and identification at the staff desk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Wait for the number and present necessary documents at the desk. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。番号でお呼びし、相談席へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. We will call your number and guide you to the consultation seat.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 待合席でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please wait in the waiting seats.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 座っていると腰がつらいです。少し立って待てる場所を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 座位でつらくなるため立てる待機場所を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Sitting makes my lower back uncomfortable. I would like advice about somewhere I can wait standing for a while.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about standing space because sitting hurts. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 状態を担当者へ伝えます。通路をふさがない場所を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will tell the person in charge your condition. Let's check for a place that does not block the passage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。自分で外へ出ると呼び出しが聞こえないので、勝手に離れず確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 呼び出しを逃さぬよう勝手に外へ出ないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please do. If I go outside myself, I cannot hear the call, so I will check instead of leaving on my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will not go outside unannounced and miss the call. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この場面では、待合の端で待つ方法を担当者と確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: In this situation, we can check with the person in charge about waiting at the edge of the waiting area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そこで待ちたいです。症状を診てもらう相談と、今の待機場所の相談は両方伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 待機相談と診療情報の両方の引き継ぎを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to wait there. Please pass on both my request for assessment of the symptoms and my request about where to wait now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to pass on both waiting arrangements and clinical information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。待機方法と診療への情報を分けて引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. We will pass on the waiting arrangements and clinical information separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: もし立っていてもつらくなったら、元の場所で我慢せずスタッフへ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 状態が変わったらスタッフへ知らせると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: If standing becomes uncomfortable too, I will tell staff instead of enduring it where I am.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will notify staff if your condition changes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お願いします。待機方法を決める時に、呼び出しをどう確認するかもご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do. When deciding how to wait, we will also explain how to check for your call.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。担当者が決めた場所で待ち、呼び出し方法も聞いてから移動します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 待機場所と呼び出し方法の確認後に移る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will wait at the place the staff member chooses and move only after hearing how I will be called.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Move after confirming the waiting place and calling method. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。まず担当者へおつなぎし、待機場所をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. First we will connect you with the staff member and show you where to wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 状況が分かる写真はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have photographs showing the situation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人が撮りましたが、私の電話にはありません。友人の画面を見ただけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人撮影の写真は自分の端末にないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend took them, but they are not on my phone. I only looked at my friend's screen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say your friend's photo is not on your own device. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご自身の端末から、その写真を出せる状態ではないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: So you cannot display that photo from your own device now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。友人から送ってもらう必要があります。写真に何が写ったかも、今は細部まで覚えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 入手方法と画像詳細の記憶の不確かさを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: That's right. I need my friend to send it. I do not remember the details of what was pictured now either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain how to obtain it and uncertainty about image details. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 写真がない状態でも、直接見たことを説明してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Even without the photo, please explain what you saw directly.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。自分が見た所と、友人の写真で見た所を混ぜずに話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 直接目撃と写真から知った内容を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I will not mix up what I saw myself with what I saw in my friend's photograph.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish direct witnessing from knowledge from a photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 写真については、友人に確認してから担当者へ相談してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: For the photo, check with your friend before consulting the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 連絡します。ただし友人の端末へ私が勝手に入ったり、似た画像で代わりにしたりはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人へ確認し無断アクセスや代替画像を避ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will contact them. But I will not access their device without permission or substitute a similar image.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check with the friend, avoiding unauthorized access and substitute images. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。入手できた場合の渡し方も担当者が案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. If you obtain it, the person in charge will also explain how to provide it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。今日は自分の目撃内容を伝え、写真は入手できたか別に報告します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人説明を先に行い写真の入手状況は後で報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. Today I will explain my own observations and report separately whether I have obtained the photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain your observations first and report photo availability later. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。本人の説明と未入手の写真を分けて担当者へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will pass on your account separately from the photo you have not obtained.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 箱の宛名が見当たりません。どちらへお送りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: I cannot see an address label on the box. Where are you sending it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ラベルが剥がれました。でもこの番号が残っているので、宛先は分かると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 剥がれた宛名を残る番号で代用できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: The label peeled off. But this number remains, so I thought you could identify the destination.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the remaining number can replace the peeled-off address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 追跡番号の表示だけで、新しい発送の宛名になるとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: A tracking number alone does not necessarily serve as an address label for a new shipment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 番号と住所は別なんですね。剥がれた紙は家にあるので、正しい住所を確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 番号と住所を区別し住所確認資料が家にあると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: The number and address are different. The peeled-off paper is at home, so I can check the correct address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish number and address and say the address document is at home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認できる住所で、新しい宛名を準備しましょう。今は発送を進めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's prepare a new address label using a verified address. We will not proceed with shipping now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。古い番号が今回の物かも分からないので、その点も見てもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 番号が今回の物か不明だと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I do not even know whether the old number belongs to this shipment, so I would like that checked too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about uncertainty whether the number is for this shipment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当者が今回の発送方法と表示を確認します。番号を自分で書き換えないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge will check this shipment's method and labeling. Do not rewrite the number yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。住所を確認するため持ち帰り、今回使う表示を案内に従って準備します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 番号を書き換えず住所と表示を準備すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I will take it home to check the address and prepare this shipment's labeling according to instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to prepare address and labeling without rewriting the number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 箱の封も緩んでいますので、持参前に中身が出ないかご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: The box's seal is loose too. Before bringing it, check that the contents cannot fall out.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。宛名だけでなく封も整え、確認できた状態で改めて出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 宛名と封の両方を整えて再持参する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will fix both the address label and seal and bring it again once checked.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Fix both label and seal and bring it again. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。今日は発送せず、準備後に担当窓口で確認いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will not send it today. The responsible counter will check after preparation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今回の振込は一回限りでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this transfer for one time only?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家賃なので毎月ですが、今日の一回を頼むつもりでした。継続設定も同じ用紙ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一回の振込と毎月の設定が同じか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is rent, so monthly, but I intended to request only today's payment. Is the recurring setup on the same form?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether a single transfer and monthly setup use the same form. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 一回の振込と継続するサービスは別に確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: A one-time transfer and an ongoing service need separate checks.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今日払う分だけで、その後も自動にしたいと決めたわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 継続の意思が未確定だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is just today's payment; I have not decided that later ones should also be automatic.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say recurring use is not decided. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 承知しました。継続をご検討なら、利用条件と変更時の扱いをご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Understood. If considering recurring use, we will explain conditions and how changes are handled.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 先に説明を聞きたいです。来月から家賃が変わるかもしれないので、固定額で始めるのは待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 金額変更の可能性から継続開始を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I want to hear the explanation first. Rent may change from next month, so I will wait before starting a fixed amount.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Hold recurring setup because the amount may change. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分かりました。設定を始める前に、金額や開始時期を決めましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. Decide the amount and start time before starting the settings.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は一回だけにして、管理会社に来月の金額が変わるか確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今回は一回に限定し翌月額を確認すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will make it just once today and ask the management company whether next month's rent changes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Limit this to one transfer and decide to check next month's amount. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。一回の手続きとして確認し、継続の申込みは行いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. We will check it as a one-time procedure and not apply for recurring service.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。今日の金額と振込先を確認し、毎月の設定は確認後に改めて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本日の取引と後日の継続相談を分けて確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will check today's amount and recipient, then ask again about monthly settings after confirming.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Separate today's transaction from later recurring advice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。今回一回の振込についてご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will guide you through this single transfer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 何かお困りのことはございますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 買うのをやめたヨーグルトを、お菓子の棚に置いてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 冷蔵商品を常温棚へ置いたと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I put yogurt I decided not to buy on the snack shelf.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report putting a chilled item on a room-temperature shelf. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 場所と、置いた時刻を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me where and when you put it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 三番の棚です。十時ごろですが、何分置いたか正確には分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 場所と時刻を示し経過時間の不確かさを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Shelf number three. Around ten o'clock, but I do not know exactly how many minutes it has been there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give place and time, noting uncertainty about elapsed time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 商品を確認します。ご自身で冷蔵棚へ戻しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check the product. Did you put it back in the chilled section yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだです。冷やせば元と同じと思って戻す前に、状態を確認してもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自己判断で冷蔵に戻さず状態確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not yet. Before assuming cooling restores it and putting it back, I want its condition checked.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not return it to refrigeration yourself; request a condition check. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。商品状態と扱いは担当者が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Thank you. The person in charge will check its condition and handling.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。別の商品を代わりに戻さず、そのヨーグルトの位置を案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別商品で代用せず対象の現物へ案内する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. I will show you that yogurt's location, not put another item back in its place.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Guide staff to the actual item without substituting another. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その商品は買わないご予定ですね。ほかに常温へ出した物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: You do not intend to buy it. Was anything else taken out to room temperature?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その一つだけです。買わずに返す物は、今後は元の場所かスタッフへ相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 対象は一つと確認し今後の戻し方を改める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Only that one. From now on, for items I return without buying, I will check the original place or ask staff.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm only one item and improve future returns. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。場所を確認し、商品は担当者が適切に扱います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will check the location, and staff will handle the item appropriately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 何かお気づきの点がございますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この時計が十時のまま動かないようです。私はこの時刻を見て待っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 動かない時計を基準に待っていたと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: This clock seems stuck at ten. I was waiting by this time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report relying on a nonmoving clock while waiting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 止まっている可能性があります。お手元の時計などでも時刻を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: It may have stopped. Check the time on your own watch or another device too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 電話で見ると十時二十分でした。家族には十時だと連絡してしまったので、訂正します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 別の時刻を確認し家族へ訂正すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: My phone says ten twenty. I told my family it was ten, so I will correct that.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check another time and say you will correct your family. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お願いします。時計の状態は管理担当へ報告します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please do. We will report the clock's condition to management.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私が登って直そうとはしません。針が動かないのをいつ見たかだけ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分で修理せず観察事実を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not climb up and try to fix it. I will only say when I saw that the hands were not moving.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not repair it yourself; report observed facts. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。最初に気づいた時刻と場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Tell me when and where you first noticed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今この広場で気づきました。いつから止まっているかは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 発見場所と発見時を示し停止開始は不明と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Just now in this square. I do not know when it stopped.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give discovery time and place, not knowing when it stopped. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かりました。停止した時刻を推測する必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. There is no need to guess its stopping time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。家族の待ち合わせは電話の時刻で確認し、公園の時計の件は報告だけにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 待ち合わせの時刻確認と設備報告を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will check my family's meeting time using the phone and only report the park clock issue.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Separate checking the meeting time from reporting equipment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらの時計について担当者へ連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will contact the person in charge about this clock.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 乗車位置をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for your boarding position?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。券に十二とあるので、十二号車に乗ると思っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 座席の列番号を車両番号と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My ticket says twelve, so I think I should board car twelve.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain mistaking the seat row number for the car number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 十二は座席の列番号です。車両は三号車と書かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Twelve is the seat row. It says car three for the carriage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 数字だけ見ていました。三号車に乗ってから、十二列の席を探すんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 車両と座席を順に確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I only looked at the number. I should board car three, then find the seat in row twelve.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check carriage and seat in order. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。ホームの三号車の表示はこちらです。席の記号も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. The platform's car-three mark is here. Check the seat letter too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 十二列のB席です。友人はC席ですが、二人で同じ席に座るという意味ではないですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二人の座席記号を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Row twelve, seat B. My friend has C, but that does not mean both of us sit in the same seat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish the two people's seat letters. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それぞれ指定された席です。友人の券にも車両が三号車か書かれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: They are separate assigned seats. Does your friend's ticket also say car three?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人のは四号車でした。隣の席だと思っていたので、合流方法を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人が別車両であると分かり合流方法を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: My friend's is car four. I thought we sat next to each other, so I will discuss how to meet up.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Notice the friend is in another car and discuss meeting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 変更をご希望なら、空席と券の条件を窓口で確認できます。勝手に席を交換してはいけません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: For changes, the counter can check availability and ticket conditions. Do not swap seats on your own.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。まず二人の車両を確認し、変更できるか聞いてから待ち合わせを決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 無断交換せず変更条件を確認して計画する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. First I will check both cars, ask whether a change is possible, then decide our meeting arrangements.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not swap without permission; check change conditions and plan. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。席の変更相談は窓口へどうぞ。乗車位置は券に合う車両でご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Ask at the counter about seat changes. Check the boarding position for the carriage matching your ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: メールでの問い合わせの続きですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is a follow-up to your email inquiry, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。送った文に前の住所を書いてしまいました。新しい内容で、最初から別に送ればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 送信済みの住所誤りと再送方法を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I put my old address in the message I sent. Should I send it separately from scratch with new content?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to resend to correct an already-sent address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 元の問い合わせと同じ件だと分かるよう、担当者への訂正方法を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check how to correct it with staff so they can identify it as the same inquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 元の送信日時は分かります。今朝九時で、件名は子どもの相談です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 元の問い合わせ日時と件名を特定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I know the original sending time: nine this morning. The subject is consultation about my child.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Identify the original inquiry's time and subject. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 分かりました。ご自身の控えに、元の内容は残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Understood. Does your own copy retain the original content?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。消して書き換えるのではなく、元のメールを見せて正しい住所を追記したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 元のメールを残して訂正したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. Rather than erase and rewrite it, I want to show the original email and add the correct address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Keep the original email and request correction. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この場面では、担当者が元の問い合わせを確認して訂正の伝え方を案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: In this situation, staff will check the original inquiry and explain how to convey the correction.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。同じ相談の住所訂正だと明記し、新しい申込みとして増やさないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別件申込みではなく同件の訂正だと明記する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. I will clearly state it is an address correction to the same consultation, not increase applications as a new one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Specify a correction to the same matter, not a separate application. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 住所のほかに訂正したい内容はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Anything else to correct besides the address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ほかは同じです。住所だけが変わることと、元の件名・日時を一緒に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 変更箇所は住所だけと整理して伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Everything else is the same. I will give the original subject and time together with the fact that only the address changes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Organize and say that only the address changes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。元の問い合わせを特定し、住所訂正の担当者へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will identify the original inquiry and refer you to the address-correction staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 本日の会計はこちらで完了です。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。これで全部終わりですか。診察で書類を受け取ると言われた気もします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会計完了と書類受け取りの完了を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Thank you. Is everything finished now? I think I was told during the consultation to collect some documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check completion of payment and document collection. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 書類の受け取りは別に確認します。何の書類と案内されましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check document collection separately. What document were you told about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 検査の案内です。名前は正確に覚えていませんが、医師のメモに丸が付いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 書類名は不確かだが医師のメモがあると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Test information. I do not remember the exact name, but there is a circle on the doctor's note.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the document name is uncertain but you have the doctor's note. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのメモを担当者に見せましょう。会計完了だけで、受け取りも終わったとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's show that note to staff. Payment completion alone does not mean collection is complete too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。分からない書類名を作らず、メモをそのまま見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 不明な名称を推測せずメモを提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I will show the note as it is rather than invent a document name I do not know.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not guess an unknown name; show the note. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この場面では、担当者が必要な受け取りと説明を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: In this situation, staff will check the necessary collection and explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 帰りの迎えを頼む前に、まだ必要な説明や待ち時間があるか教えてほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 迎えの連絡前に残る説明と待ち時間を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Before asking someone to pick me up, I want to know whether there are explanations or waiting time still needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask remaining explanations and wait time before contacting your ride. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当者から案内します。書類の説明が済むまで、受付付近でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Staff will advise you. Please wait near reception until the document explanation is finished.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。迎えにはまだ終了が確定していないと伝え、案内を聞いてから帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 終了未確定を迎えへ伝え案内後に退出する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will tell my ride that finishing is not yet confirmed and go home after hearing the instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tell your ride completion is unconfirmed and leave after guidance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。書類受け取りの確認として担当者へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will refer this as a check on document collection.
